docs.title: Did you know you can enable RAG functionality on an AI agent?
Did you know you can enable RAG functionality on an AI agent?
docs.text:
To enable RAG functionality on your agent, go to its configuration and enable the Can Use RAG option. Then, in the assistant step called Knowledge Base, you can attach one or more RAG configurations containing the documents the agent will interpret.

Once configured correctly, you will be able to query the agent about the information contained in those documents.

docs.title: Did you know you can use AI in the Flexygo app?
Did you know you can use AI in the Flexygo app?
docs.text: If your Flexygo instance has an AI assistant configured, you can access it directly from the mobile application, as long as you have an internet connection.

docs.title: Technical implementation
docs.text: To enable this feature, use the JavaScript function flexygo.nav.goAI, passing the assistant's identifier as a parameter. This instruction will automatically navigate to a dedicated screen where you can interact with the AI assistant.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
• An AI assistant configured in your Flexygo instance
  • An active internet connection on the mobile device

docs.title: Did you know Flexygo's AI can autocomplete any text?
Did you know Flexygo's AI can autocomplete any text?
docs.text:
Flexygo offers an AI-powered autocomplete capability. To use it, you need to select the desired agent in the property's configuration.

With this feature enabled, the AI can assist with various tasks such as:

  • Writing news content
  • Drafting emails
  • Reviewing code
  • Other custom functionality

The system uses the form's fields that trigger the autocomplete capability as its basis, generating contextualized text based on the data available in the form.

docs.title: Did you know Flexygo's AI can create objects for you?
Did you know Flexygo's AI can create objects for you?
docs.text: Flexygo's AI assistant can create new objects based on a specific table. For example, you can ask the assistant: "Create the object for the Customers table".

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Functionality based on natural-language commands
  • Automatic generation of objects from existing tables

docs.title: Did you know you can set default prompts on an AI agent?
Did you know you can set default prompts on an AI agent?
docs.text:
From your agent's configuration, in the section called Prompts, you can set default instructions. This feature makes it easier for users to provide information to the agent.

The goal is to simplify the initial interaction, letting you define in advance what kind of data or context the agent should request or consider by default.

Did you know Flexygo's AI can explain a SQL query to you?
docs.text: If your agent is able to run queries against the database, you can ask it to explain any query to make it easier to understand.

Did you know Flexygo's AI can generate your data model?
docs.text: From the wizard for creating a new object, you can select the Create data model button. Using this option, the AI assistant called Aitor "Lowdy" can help you generate the scripts needed for your data model according to your specific requirements.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Automatic generation of table structures (for example, a Customers table and its related Contacts)
  • Creation of scripts with sample data
  • Option to create objects from the tables after running the scripts
